listing.name: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled (sciaschi)
listing.summary: Explore Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled (sciaschi) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep an existing permitted copy
steps.instruction: If you already have a permitted, prepared copy, choose its ConkerRecompiled.exe game executable and supplied working folder in the existing-installation review. Use your own supported USA Conker ROM in the game’s picker. Keep its existing conker_data and user-profile saves/settings together with the upstream migration instructions. Saving those launch details does not run it; launch separately when ready.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with upstream
steps.instruction: Retain the working folder and original game files. Follow the selected upstream version’s update instructions using a separate replacement folder. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external runtime or its user-profile data.
